name: dsh-cookie-pruner
description: DSH 桌面端 dsh-auth-* cookie 累积（HTTP 431 / Web authentication failed 启动崩溃）缓解插件。在左下角「账户 → 设置」里新增一个诚实的「Cookie 清理」分区：说明插件沙箱无法直接读/删 cookie 的架构限制、展示探测证明，并给出离线 cleanup-once.ps1 路径与步骤（真正解除 431）。Layer A（cookieMaxAgeDays:7）已在生效，防止未来 cookie 堆积。 / Honest DSH desktop dsh-auth-* cookie pile-up (HTTP 431) mitigation: a "Cookie 清理" section in the bottom-left account → Settings dialog that explains the plugin-sandbox limitation, shows the proof, and points to the offline cleanup-once.ps1 that actually fixes 431. Layer A (cookieMaxAgeDays:7) prevents future pile-up.
